name: Conversations with the Devil
source:
The Powers That Be have gifted you with the rare opportunity to meet a devil they've sequestered underground. The metal door to the cell swings open. Your stomach twists in anxiety as regret begins to curdle in your stomach. This is definitely a mistake.

[From [url=https://sirizchai.itch.io/conversations-with-the-devil]itch.io[/url]]
